name: Step into the Void
summary: The enemy takes a step and the ground is gone. But the void always takes its toll.

face.name: Step into the Void

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Choose an Entity the opponent controls and put it into its owner's Requiem Zone. If it had an assigned Object, put that Object into the Abyss. Then roll a d6: on 1–2 you lose 4 HP, on 3–4 you lose 3 HP, on 5–6 you lose 2 HP.

face.flavor: They did not parry the blow. They removed the target.
